# montecarlo_warehouse (Data Source)

A warehouse groups the connections Monte Carlo uses to monitor one data platform, such as a Snowflake account or a Databricks workspace. It runs on a deployment, and every connection added to it goes through that deployment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `warehouse_id` (String) Id of the warehouse, as returned when it is created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) When the warehouse was created.
- `deployment_id` (String) The deployment the warehouse's connections run through. Null for a warehouse that has no deployment. The id may name a deployment on Monte Carlo's older collection platform. The deployments endpoints do not list those.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the warehouse.
- `name` (String) Display name of the warehouse. Null for a warehouse that was never named.
- `type` (String) The kind of data platform the warehouse represents. Fixed once created.
